title: Daily digest: Dear techies: Forget work from home, try | Japan seeks steady supply of rare earth  | Ujjal Biswas, former Bengal minister die
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: Dear techies: Forget work from home, try 'work from lakes’, thanks to CM Revanth.
Japan has sought steady supply of rare earth minerals from Andhra.
Ujjal Biswas, former Bengal minister dies after prolonged illness, Mamata expresses grief.
bullets_ur: Techies bhaiyon: Ghar se kaam bhool jao, 'work from lakes' aazmao, CM Revanth ki wajah se
Japan ne Andhra se rare earth minerals ki mustaqil supply maang li
Ujjal Biswas, purana Bengal wazir, lambi bemari ke baad wafat, Mamata ne gham ka izhar kiya
